verdict.rationale: Mercury documents international wire payouts and advertises no-fee USD payments worldwide, which covers sending international payments with a clear fee position for USD. Nothing in the evidence shows sending in local or foreign currencies, FX rates, or a fee breakdown for non-USD transfers. missing for 10: local-currency (FX) international payments, documented FX rates/markups and fee disclosure for non-USD sends, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can send international payments in local currencies with transparent fees
